events.claimed: President Kennedy shot in Dallas. Official early narrative: lone gunman Lee Harvey Oswald.
events.surfaced: Warren Commission (1964) backs lone-gunman frame; critics immediately dispute single-bullet and timeline details.

events.claimed: Public doubt grows; House Select Committee on Assassinations (HSCA) convened.
events.surfaced: HSCA concludes probable conspiracy based largely on acoustic evidence later contested; still rejects many popular plots.

events.claimed: JFK Records Act orders release of assassination records.
events.surfaced: Assassination Records Review Board oversees massive transfers to NARA; waves of releases follow for decades.

events.claimed: Remaining withheld records will clear everything up.
events.surfaced: Multiple release waves (incl. 2025). Tons of paperwork; no single smoking-gun file that ends debate. Dig the PDFs.

events.claimed: Cold War: need defenses against 'brainwashing' and interrogation drugs.
events.surfaced: CIA launches MKUltra umbrella funding behavioral research, including LSD and unwitting subjects.

events.claimed: Program quietly wound down; many files ordered destroyed.
events.surfaced: Destruction confirmed later — surviving financials and testimony become the backbone of what we know.

events.claimed: Church Committee / Senate hearings will expose mind-control extremes.
events.surfaced: Hearings put MKUltra on the record: drugs, front orgs, ethics failures. Not every rumor equals a memo.

events.claimed: Immediate public story: al-Qaeda hijackings; buildings fail from impact and fire.
events.surfaced: Emergency response chaos; rapid political consensus for wars; early alternative theories spread online.

events.claimed: Independent commission will answer all questions.
events.surfaced: 9/11 Commission Report published July 2004 — detailed but critics flag ignored leads and WTC 7 timing.

events.claimed: NIST engineering reports settle collapse mechanics.
events.surfaced: NIST WTC studies released; WTC 7 report 2008. Engineers still argue fire vs demolition frames in public forums.

events.claimed: Florida deal quietly resolves Epstein case.
events.surfaced: Non-prosecution agreement later blasted; OPR reviews Acosta/DOJ handling years after.

events.claimed: New federal charges; death in custody ends trial.
events.surfaced: Arrest, indictment, death ruled suicide by NYC ME; skepticism remains loud. Flight logs and black book circulate as public artifacts.

events.claimed: Civil discovery will name everyone.
events.surfaced: Giuffre v. Maxwell unsealing dumps large document sets. Names in filings ≠ proven guilt — read the docket.

events.claimed: NYT AATIP story + Navy videos mean secret crash-retrieval programs.
events.surfaced: Pentagon confirms videos are authentic UAP footage; program history gets messy in follow-ups.

events.claimed: Whistleblower hearing will force full disclosure.
events.surfaced: House hearing with Grusch/Fravor/Graves. Sworn claims of retrieval programs; AARO/DoD dispute crash-retrieval evidence.

events.claimed: Historical review will prove legacy cover-up — or close the case.
events.surfaced: AARO Historical Record Report Vol. 1 finds no evidence of extraterrestrial tech in reviewed holdings; believers call scope incomplete.

events.claimed: USS Maddox clash with North Vietnamese boats.
events.surfaced: Real engagement on Aug 2 becomes part of escalation case.

events.claimed: Second attack forces Congress to authorize force.
events.surfaced: Gulf of Tonkin Resolution passes. Later SIGINT reviews say Aug 4 attack did not happen as sold.

events.claimed: Declassification settles the history.
events.surfaced: NSA releases Hanyok study and related materials — classic 'called it' for critics of the pretext.

events.claimed: Public health messaging leans zoonotic / natural spillover; lab-leak talk dismissed as fringe.
events.surfaced: WHO China joint study; letters and papers circulate; social platforms throttle some lab-leak posts.

events.claimed: Lab-leak becomes discussable in mainstream outlets.
events.surfaced: Biden orders intel assessment; some agencies lean natural, some undecided, one leans lab. No consensus slam-dunk.

events.claimed: Hearings and FOIA will prove one origin story.
events.surfaced: More emails, grant trails, and committee probes. Still contested — dig primary intel summaries and FOIA dumps yourself.

events.claimed: Secret Jekyll Island meeting plots a private central bank.
events.surfaced: Bankers and politicians did meet at Jekyll Island to draft a plan that informed the Federal Reserve Act — on the record in histories the Fed itself recounts.

events.claimed: Fed Act sneaks through while country sleeps.
events.surfaced: Act signed by Wilson after public debate and legislative process. Structure: public/private hybrid with regional banks — still argued over.

events.claimed: QE and emergency facilities prove the Fed answers only to banks.
events.surfaced: Crisis facilities, audits fights (e.g. GAO limits), and transparency debates continue. Read the Act and the transcripts.

events.claimed: Believers: stolen via machines/mail. Officials: secure election.
events.surfaced: Dozens of lawsuits filed; most dismissed for standing/evidence. Some counties audit; CISA calls it secure — critics reject CISA.

events.claimed: Protest becomes Capitol breach; narratives split hard left/right.
events.surfaced: Criminal cases, congressional investigation, and competing media frames. Primary: charging docs and hearing records.

events.claimed: Machine-vendor and ballot lawsuits will flip certification.
events.surfaced: Ongoing civil fights and state law changes. No court-ordered nationwide reverse. Keep reading dockets, not just clips.

events.claimed: Apollo 11 lands; Armstrong/Aldrin walk.
events.surfaced: Global broadcast; rock samples; Soviet tracking. Hoax theories grow later with film/photo arguments.

events.claimed: Believers: studio flags, lighting, Van Allen belts make it impossible.
events.surfaced: NASA and independent physicists publish rebuttals; laser retroreflectors left on Moon still used.

events.claimed: New imagery will expose fake sites — or confirm them.
events.surfaced: LRO photos show landers/tracks at Apollo sites. Debate continues in believer communities anyway — dig both stacks.
